text.text: The Cisco 4221 Integrated Services Router (ISR) is purpose-built for small and medium businesses and comes with IOS security: Zone-based firewall, NAT services, and Snort IPS, and supports Stealthwatch Learning Networks (SLN) License and support Umbrella Branch. It provides up to 75 Mbps performance in a 1-rack unit (1RU) desktop form factor, with two NIM slots, and zero SM slots.
